source: Built from tests/fixtures/ios27-misrenders.swift, exported with the repo's own exporter (projectFromFiles + buildExportBundle, deploymentTarget 27.0) and compiled with Xcode 27.0 (build 27A266a) on macOS 27.0; run on the iPhone 18 Pro simulator (088B21CA-E114-42A3-948D-2C682861FDB1) with the iOS 27.0 runtime (24A434), light appearance forced with simctl ui, status bar overridden to 9:41 / charged / 100%; one launch per screen with -screen <name>, captured with simctl io screenshot (sRGB-tagged PNGs, display corners not masked; every capture has a 1 pt black simulator dot at (0,0)) on 2026-09-23. 1206x2622 pixels / 402x874 points at 3x. The four search-placement screens (search-content, search-tab-content, search-tab-stack, search-drawer) were added to the fixture and captured in a second run the same day, with the same build and device; the fixture's other screens are unchanged, so the earlier captures stand.

measured.units: points (pixels / 3) on a 402x874 pt screen; angles in degrees clockwise on screen from 3 o'clock; colours are sRGB 0-255 read from sRGB-tagged PNGs

deviceSafeArea.note: from safe-bg-closure: its background covers exactly y 62-840

trimStart.RoundedRectangle: middle of the right edge (3 o'clock), clockwise on screen: down the right edge first
trimStart.Capsule: rightmost point at mid-height (3 o'clock); for a vertical capsule the middle of the right edge; clockwise on screen
trimStart.Rectangle: top-left corner, clockwise on screen: along the top edge first

interpretation.pathAddArcClockwiseFlag: clockwise: false draws clockwise on screen, clockwise: true draws counterclockwise on screen (y-down flip)
interpretation.templateRing: addArc(-90 -> 270, clockwise: true) is a full circle starting at 12 o'clock and running counterclockwise on screen; trim(0, 0.65) covers 12 o'clock counterclockwise round to 36 degrees (about 4:10), leaving the upper-right gap
interpretation.trimmedFill: Circle().trim(0, 0.5).fill closes the trimmed arc with a straight chord: the lower half disc, flat edge on the horizontal diameter
interpretation.linearGradientBackground: interpolated in Oklab over the view frame (safe area, y 62-840); the parts under the status bar and home indicator repeat the end colours

colors.layout: 50x50 pt swatches, 8 pt gaps, 6 per row, first at (10, 80) pt; index i at x = 10 + (i % 6) * 58, y = 80 + floor(i / 6) * 58
colors.method: Mean of a 5x5 pixel patch at each swatch centre. colors.png has a white page, colors-black.png the same grid on black; derivedRGBA solves a*C + (1-a)*bg for the swatches that are not opaque (low-alpha values are quantised: +-1 on the black capture moves C by about 1/a).

trim.note: centreLine.runs[].from/to.on names the outline segment the point lies on (a Capsule's "corners" are its semicircular ends, so its 3 o'clock point is reported as the start of the bottom-right corner); from/to are in clockwise order and local is relative to the frame origin. Positions are sampled every 0.05 pt, so the Rectangle start [0.1, 0] is its top-left corner.

tabBar.note: bounds of pixels differing from red by more than 12 below y 700 (glass pill plus its shadow)

search-content.note: .searchable on a twelve-row List inside a NavigationStack with no TabView; the field is where search-root, which writes it on the stack, has it
search-content.uikit: searchController placement 1, allows toolbar integration; UISearchBarTextField frame [28, 808, 374, 836], in the bottom toolbar

search-tab-content.note: .searchable on the List inside a tab page's NavigationStack; search-tab-stack, with it on that stack, is byte-identical
search-tab-content.searchFieldAtRest: none drawn: nothing but the page between the title and the list card (y 153-168) or beside the tab bar (y 792-874)
search-tab-content.uikit: searchController placement 2 (stacked), hidesWhenScrolling; UISearchBarTextField frame [16, 168, 386, 168], folded to no height under the title

afterPullingDown.how: list contentOffset set 120 pt past the top, then back to the new top inset (222)
afterPullingDown.note: the same as the searchSurface of native/iphone18pro-light, measured in a tab app on 2026-09-16

search-drawer.note: .searchable(text:placement: .navigationBarDrawer(displayMode: .always)) on the List; the title is drawn inline, not large
